ModMetaData.name: Deep Colony
ModMetaData.author: azraelgodking
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists are more than their stats. Five systems — auto skill perks, trauma and therapy, apprenticeship, family, and a living faction reputation ledger — give the colony a history.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/deep-colony Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
